items.title: Agent browser for macOS workflows
items.oneliner: WebKit browser for coding agents that isolates workspaces, suspends idle tabs, and keeps passwords out of logs.

items.title: Open observability dashboards as code
items.oneliner: Dashboard platform for Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope with a CLI and SDKs for GitOps workflows.

items.title: GGML reaches stable 1.0 release
items.oneliner: Local inference tensor library adds FP8, Vulkan and Metal improvements, and faster RPC for multi-device model serving.

items.title: DeepSeek V3 in pure JAX
items.oneliner: Readable 190-line JAX implementation of DeepSeek V3 features MLA, MoE, and training code you can inspect.

items.title: Open RISC-V core running Linux
items.oneliner: SystemVerilog RV64 out-of-order CPU boots Linux 6.6 and BusyBox, with full source for hardware hackers.

items.title: Probabilistic data structures in Go
items.oneliner: Hands-on Go guide shows Bloom filters and other sketches that trade exactness for major memory savings.

items.title: Build a self-booting ZIP archive
items.oneliner: Step-by-step systems tutorial shows how to make a ZIP file boot directly in QEMU.

items.title: Write your own PostScript interpreter
items.oneliner: Implementation walkthrough builds a small PostScript interpreter while teaching stacks, parsing, and language runtime design.

items.title: Debugging a WebKit promise bug

items.title: Terminal borders without wasted cells
